crossRefs.note: When the ark went forward, Moses said, “Rise up, Yahweh, and let your enemies be scattered! Let those who hate you flee…
When it rested, he said, “Return, Yahweh, to the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel.”
Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so they encamped by their standards, and…
he says, who hears the words of God, who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:
How goodly are your tents, Jacob, and your dwellings, Israel!
Who is she who looks out as the morning, beautiful as the moon, clear as the sun, and awesome as an army with banners?
for God is not a God of confusion, but of peace, as in all the assemblies of the saints.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Thus were the travels of the children of Israel according to their armies; and they went forward.
translations.bsb: This was the order of march for the Israelite divisions as they set out.
translations.kjv: Thus were the journeyings of the children of Israel according to their armies, when they set forward.
translations.asv: Thus were the journeyings of the children of Israel according to their hosts; and they set forward.
